reviews.title: Do NOT buy this CPU cooler.
reviews.comment: Bought this part a couple of months back for a PC build. Worked alright for about a month until my apartment lost power for about 3 seconds. Despite my computer being attached to a surge protector this part completely stopped functioning after. I tried contacting Lian Li for either a replacement part or a refund, and their website gives no contact info at all. Embarrassing and frustrating.
reviews.author: Blake A.
